## What is Token Reducer?

**Token Reducer** is a free, open-source Claude Code plugin that cuts token usage by **90–98%** using hybrid retrieval — combining BM25 keyword search, ONNX vector embeddings, AST-aware chunking, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion. It runs **100% locally** — no API calls, no cloud dependencies, no data leaves your machine.

> Built for developers who hit Claude's rate limits or want to reduce API costs without sacrificing context quality.

---

## Install

```bash
# Option 1 — Claude Code plugin marketplace (recommended)
/plugin add token-reducer

# Option 2 — pip
pip install token-reducer
```

## Highlights

- **Hybrid Retrieval** — BM25 (SQLite FTS5) + ONNX semantic vectors fused via RRF
- **AST-Aware Chunking** — Tree-sitter parses Python, JS, TS, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, Ruby
- **Reranking** — TextRank + symbol graph for precision context selection
- **Zero Cloud** — fully offline, CPU-only inference with all-MiniLM-L6-v2
- **Sub-100ms** — faster than Language Server alternatives
